title: Project switcher: status pills, a Current pill and a Remove button — round 1

steps.headline: The project switcher is now a normal popup: title and ✕, a search box, your projects in one box, Add a project below.
steps.changed: Same shell as Settings and Session details. The search box is a real field with its icon. "Add a project" is a full-width outlined button.
steps.notice: Typing still filters, ↑ ↓ and Enter still pick, Esc still closes. Only the list scrolls when you have many projects.

steps.headline: Sync shows as a named pill, like Working and Inactive in the session switcher: Synced, Sync problem, Sync stopped, Only on this computer.
steps.changed: The bare coloured dot became a pill with its dot and a word. The check mark became a "Current" pill. Each row has a bin at its end.
steps.notice: The words match the sync pill on the project's own page. Hovering a pill still gives the full sentence.

steps.path: Projects → click the name, with many projects (one folder moved away)
steps.headline: With many projects only the list scrolls, fading at its edges; a project whose folder is gone says "Folder missing".
steps.changed: New: a project whose folder was moved or deleted outside YouCoded gets an amber "Folder missing" pill instead of a sync pill.
steps.notice: That is usually the project you want to remove. The search box and Add a project never scroll away.

steps.path: Project switcher → bin on a plain folder
steps.headline: Removing a plain folder asks first and says plainly that the folder and its files stay where they are.
steps.changed: The confirm is the shared popup now: title, ✕, red Remove on top and Cancel under it, full width.
steps.notice: Same behaviour as before: it leaves your project list and the new-conversation folder list. The optional tick deletes only YouCoded's own file history.

steps.path: Project switcher → bin on a synced project
steps.headline: Synced projects can now be removed: they leave this computer's list only and keep syncing.
steps.changed: Before, synced projects had no remove at all.
steps.notice: Nothing is deleted; sync isn't stopped (asked in PQ-1). Add a project brings it back.

steps.path: Project switcher → bin on a project whose folder is missing
steps.headline: Removing a project whose folder is gone just takes it off your list, and says so.
steps.changed: A short version of the confirm with no tick box — there is nothing left on disk to tidy.

steps.path: Projects page, a synced project open
steps.headline: The project's own page now shows "Remove from YouCoded" for synced projects too, matching the switcher.
steps.changed: A red outlined "Remove from YouCoded" button now sits beside Rename on a synced project. Before, synced projects had none (no picture of before: the old page was not photographed).
steps.notice: It opens the same confirm as the switcher's bin.

steps.path: Project switcher at phone width, many projects
steps.headline: At phone width the counts hide and the pills stay; long names shorten to make room.
steps.changed: Same rows, narrower. The counts go (they also hid before), the path and pills stay.
steps.notice: "Only on this computer" is the widest pill and squeezes a long name like wecoded-marketplace (see PQ-2).

steps.headline: In a small window the popup fits: two rows show and the list scrolls between the search box and Add a project.
steps.changed: Nothing special for small windows — the list just gets shorter.
steps.notice: The search box and Add a project stay on screen.

steps.headline: How should each project's file and chat counts show?
steps.notice: The counts hide at phone width in all three. My pick is the first: it is the guide's own recipe for a number in a summary line.

variants.label: Bold numbers
variants.summary: "21 files · 5 chats" at the right of the second line, the numbers bold and the words grey.

variants.label: Two chips
variants.summary: "21 files" and "5 chats" as two small fact chips, like the Marketplace detail pages.
variants.risk: Busier: each row then has chips and a pill.

variants.label: No counts
variants.summary: No numbers in the switcher at all; the project's page still shows them.
variants.risk: You can't tell an empty project from a busy one before opening it.

steps.path: Project switcher, the project you are in
steps.headline: How should the project you're already in be marked, now the check mark is gone?
steps.notice: My pick is the pill: it says what it means in a word, like the status pills.

variants.label: Current pill
variants.summary: A small "Current" pill beside its name.

variants.label: Tinted row
variants.summary: Its whole row is tinted; no word.
variants.risk: A tint alone can be mistaken for the row your pointer is on.

variants.label: Its own box
variants.summary: It sits alone under "Current project", the others under "Other projects".
variants.risk: Taller popup; while you search it goes back into the one list.

steps.headline: Should the remove bin show on every row all the time, or only on the row your pointer is on?
steps.notice: On a phone or touch screen the bin always shows in both. My pick is always: Remove is easy to find, which was the complaint.

variants.label: Always shown
variants.summary: A grey bin at the end of every row; it turns red when you point at it.

variants.label: On the pointed row
variants.summary: The bin appears only on the row under the pointer or the keyboard highlight.
variants.risk: Quieter, but you have to know to point at a row to find Remove.

steps.path: Project switcher → bin on a synced project
steps.headline: When you remove a synced project, what should happen to its syncing?
steps.today: In this draft, removing a synced project only hides it on this computer. Its folder in YouCoded › Projects keeps syncing with your other devices, which still list it.
steps.problem: Hidden but still syncing means the folder keeps changing on this computer without you seeing it in the app.
steps.proposal: Pick what Remove should mean for a synced project. Nothing in any option deletes your files unless you choose the last one.

options.label: Hide here only
pros: Safe: nothing changes on your other devices
easy to undo with Add a project. Built.
cons: The hidden folder keeps syncing in the background.

options.label: Also stop syncing
pros: Nothing changes behind your back after you remove it.
cons: Stopping sync is permanent and applies on every device (today's Stop syncing has no undo).

options.label: Offer the trash too
pros: One place to get rid of a project completely.
cons: Moves real files to the trash — easy to do by accident
on a synced project it would delete them on every device.

steps.headline: Should folders that don't sync still carry an "Only on this computer" pill on every row?
steps.today: Every project that isn't synced shows a grey "Only on this computer" pill, the same words as the project page's sync pill.
steps.problem: Most people's projects aren't synced, so most rows carry the widest pill, and on a phone it squeezes long names.
steps.proposal: Keep it, shorten it, or show nothing for unsynced folders so only synced ones carry a pill.

options.label: Keep as is
pros: Matches the project page word for word
every row says where it lives.

options.label: Shorter: Not synced
pros: still says it on every row.
cons: Differs from the project page's words unless that changes too.

options.label: No pill
pros: a pill then always means sync is on.
cons: An unsynced row says nothing about sync.
